articles.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
articles.snippet: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

articles.title: Chinese newspaper warns of Bitcoin extortion scam using its name
articles.snippet: China Business Journal says fraudsters impersonated the publication, demanding Bitcoin to suppress purported investigative reports about targeted companies.

articles.title: Japanese game developer launches Bitcoin, altcoin fund with SBI
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin and altcoin fund builds on Gumi’s growing crypto business centered around XRP, with the company nearly doubling its crypto holdings over the past year.

articles.title: The 100x obsession: Fundamentals grow in importance as crypto matures
articles.snippet: Crypto’s fundamentals have never been stronger, yet degens keep chasing hot new narratives. Behavioral finance may explain why get-rich-quick stories continue to beat substance.

articles.title: Fake Flare Network Staking Site Drained $8.5M in XRP: Seoul Police
articles.snippet: The ring copied Flare Network and its FXRP token, and planted Wikipedia entries, blog posts and YouTube videos to look legitimate.
